2. This first application under Section 483 of BNSS, 2023 has been filed for grant of bail.

3. The applicant is in jail from 16.3.2024 in connection with Crime No.49/2024 registered at Police Station - Chandpur, District Alirajpur for offence under Section 376, 376(2)(e), 376(3) of IPC and Section 3 and 4 of POCSO Act.
3. After arguing the matter at length, counsel for the applicant seeks permission of this Court to withdraw this application.
4. Accordingly the application is dismissed as withdrawn.
